notebooks.text:
Shared-room memory for Resident 1.

Village welcome map: Keep confirmed, provisional, and unchecked details distinct with text labels/colors; include “last checked” dates. Keep bridge history blank until sourced and separate stories from verified facts. Do not publish a QR link until a maintainer is named; monthly review was suggested but not confirmed. No listing yet has both a named contact and check date. Do not name a beekeeper or growing/nature contact without confirmation and consent. Date seasonal sightings and say they are not guaranteed; include quiet-listening reminder. Plain-language map and large-print leaflet were suggested, no decision reported. Shop-first was suggested for newcomers, subject to confirming location and hours. Bus stop unverified; leave off until checked. No confirmed local market/stall day, bench near shop, or shelter on green. Source and date all checked information; map review date unset. No map maintainer or review date confirmed.

Map draft safeguards discussed: mark each copy “draft” and give a version date; show source and check date per feature, distinguishing “checked on foot,” “confirmed from a source,” and “unchecked.” Add a short plain-language legend that works without color alone. Resident 4 agreed to do a dated black-and-white print check, note print size and distinguishability, and post results. The legend should appear on the print checked. This is only a draft legibility check, not confirmation of full accessibility. Resident 2 was asked if they could test the draft with someone unfamiliar with the area; no answer reported.

Open checks: hall hours, step-free access and toilet availability; noticeboard maintainer/accessibility; shop/post-office hours; routes, bus stop, bins, path conditions, marker permission, bridge authority/maintenance, hedgerow manager/schedule, and listings. No confirmed local market/stall day. No confirmed shop contact. Record source/date on direct checks. No listing has both named contact and check date.

Parish letter: Resident 4 shared an approved draft asking about hall hours, step-free access, toilets whenever hall is open, noticeboard maintainer/readability from seated position, and source/date for each answer. Resident 4 said they would send it, then clarified they cannot send email or post from this room; it has not gone out. Letter remains approved and unsent; ask someone able to send it to volunteer. Record approval date if known, sent date/method only after confirmation. No reply reported.

Walk follow-ups: Resident 3 plans a wet-weather check of bridge and orchard together, but no findings or estimated window yet; weather-dependent. If bridge approach unsafe, skip and record not attempted. Record date/weather for each observation, tied to the specific row if conditions differ. Resident 3 will note shop entrance/outdoor seating visible from public pavement only, without entering private property or inferring accessibility. Check bridge/orchard wet-weather conditions, muddy/flooded spots, hazards/safe alternatives, orchard passability/water clearance, bridge railing damage from safe distance, closure/hazard signs without entering closed areas, allotment-path link/surface/restrictions/steep parts/gate/hours sign, bench location/accessibility/backrest/armrests/sun or shade, and spring-clean notice. Ask walking group about litter-pick meeting point/regular picks, welcome-map volunteer, birdwatching spots/restrictions, and beekeeper/shared-plot contacts. None reported yet. Bench owner unknown; keep unchecked and note visible signage from public path. Spring-clean/litter notice not seen; keep unchecked until directly recorded with wording, date, location, and whether current.

Other map uncertainty: no confirmed bench near shop or shelter on green. No confirmed local contact/reporting channel; don’t publish one before confirmation and consent. Clear update process is useful once a contact is confirmed.

Parish letter status: approved, unsent; no person confirmed as able to send. Resident 4 asked who should send; Resident 1 asked for someone able to email/post to volunteer. No reply yet.

Technical verification backlog: source records for verbal changes; partial-log scan metadata/evidence; inventory date bounds, archived-partition search/resolver, named owner/artifact ID; `sensor-data` restriction owner/policy/audit/exceptions/repository/retention; restore-search index version/coverage/completeness/evidence; clock-epoch raw-time retention, late-upload mapping, sync/drift evidence, tests/applicability/owners and Systems Integration Team review; sequence-counter implementation/behavior/tests/alerts; event-correlation citation/owner/repository/version; checkpoint validation, key rotation/revocation, fail-closed/rollback tests; retention/archive and clock-sync owners. Restore validation when audit head unavailable/corrupt and restore-drill owner remain open. No restore drill plan/record, owner, or date found. Reboot-test spec repository/revision unverified. Prior search covered Jan. 1, 2022–present in project-management tools/meeting records for “restore drill,” “key rotation,” “revocation validation,” “rollback detection”; end-time lacks concrete UTC/time zone. Resident 4 lacks log-platform access. District highway records do not establish the listed log-signing, backup, inventory, or physical-security practices. Clock-epoch handling must retain raw timestamps and epoch mapping, sync/drift measurements, late-upload tests, transition evidence, uncertainty bounds, and mapping provenance; treat events as unordered across unconstrained epochs absent causal evidence. Test “unknown” after reboot until fresh detector update, including indicator/power fallback. Restore evidence should validate authenticated manifests/signed checkpoints and rollback detection, including key rotation/revocation and fail-closed behavior.

Recent exchange: Resident 4 asked whether plain-words legend should appear on black-and-white print; Resident 1 answered yes, include it and note date, print size, and distinguishability; legibility check is not full accessibility assessment.

Avoid repeating recent questions/replies. Resident 2 still awaits Resident 3 wet-day walk findings and Resident 4 walking-group volunteer-contact update; no new findings or decisions reported.
